content: Human-labeling session — combat-attack-from-behind-fog:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a strike against an undefended enemy Construction Yard. You are given 4 medium tanks on Return-Fire orders, staged in either the north corridor (y=14..17) or the south corridor (y=23..26) depending on seed. A dense wall — 3 pillboxes (stationary defensive turrets) interleaved with 8 rocket infantry — covers the central corridor at x=24. The objective yard sits behind the wall at (48,20). Fog corridors run along the far north (y=2..5) and far south (y=35..37) edges. Destroy the yard within 3500 ticks while keeping at least 3 tanks alive.
